preview.text: Canada won the toss and chose to bat first in this one-day match against Nepal at Al Amerat Cricket Ground (Ministry Turf 1). In 7 recorded one-day meetings between them, Canada won 2 and Nepal won 5. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 33 degrees.

summary.text: Canada won by 24 runs. CAN made 256-10, Yuvraj Samra top-scoring with 105 off 117 balls; Lalit Rajbanshi took 4 for 39. NEP made 232-10, Arjun Kumal top-scoring with 87 off 112 balls; Sukhjinder Singh took 3 for 38.
